desc: Implement complete Python solution using capped pair-sum frequency algorithm with early cases T <= 0, T > min(FA, FB), and T == 1.

Generate candidate sums from fixed A/B values with capped multiplicity min(countA[a], countB[b], T), filter sums below maxS, and check whether any sum appears at least T times using encoded list sort.
Verify edge cases and public sample tests.
